<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex14022026-10-1309-30-08" status="reviewed"> shes rab kyi zhes pa la <expan>sogs</expan> la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs></note> sgrub byed <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="16b6"/> mthong pa yin te de yang rjes dpag tshad mas grub pa las rtags dgod pa ni stong nyid sgom pa'i blo <expan>chos can</expan> | goms pa'i yan 
lag dang ma bral na gsal ba mthar thug 'byung nges te rten brtan zhing goms pa las ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro || 
'dod pa la <expan>sogs</expan> goms pa <expan>bzhin no</expan> <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="16b7"/> zhes smra ba mi 
'thad pa la gnyis las 
khyab pa mi 'thad pa ni rgyu tshogs pa la 'bras bu skyed nges kyis ma khyab pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> || 
gal te goMs pa'i yan lag dang ma bral na zhes pa'i mtha' gzhan bkag pa'i nges pa sgrub pas skyon med ces pa 'khrul te rtag pa mtha' bzung ste <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="16b8"/> tshad mas ma grub pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
